title: Mouse in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- scarf ends -->
  <path d='M68 62 Q74 72 68 82 L76 80 Q80 70 74 60 Z' fill='#e63946'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#9aa7b8'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#b8c4d4'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='20' fill='#9aa7b8'/>
  <!-- ear left -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='34' r='10' fill='#9aa7b8'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='34' r='6' fill='#f0a3b1'/>
  <!-- ear right -->
  <circle cx='67' cy='34' r='10' fill='#9aa7b8'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='34' r='6' fill='#f0a3b1'/>
  <!-- face lighter shade -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#b8c4d4'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='48' r='3' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='48' r='3' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='3' fill='#f0a3b1'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='30' y1='54' x2='42' y2='56' stroke='#d6dee8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='60' x2='42' y2='59' stroke='#d6dee8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='54' x2='58' y2='56' stroke='#d6dee8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='60' x2='58' y2='59' stroke='#d6dee8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- scarf wrapped around neck -->
  <path d='M28 62 Q50 72 72 62 Q72 68 50 78 Q28 68 28 62 Z' fill='#e63946'/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <path d='M36 65 Q50 72 64 65' stroke='#f4a261' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='88' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f0a3b1'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='88' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f0a3b1'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 78 Q86 82 82 68' stroke='#b8c4d4' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
